# Test fixtures

Synthetic/curated inputs only; no production files or credentials.

- `visual_minimal.ppt`, `visual_video.ppt`: legacy PowerPoint/media conversion.
- [notes/](notes/README.md): six transcript/reference pairs for evidence checks.
- [stt/](stt/README.md): private local audio guidance; no committed recordings.

Keep fixtures small and redistributable. Offline tests use fake providers.
See [test commands](../../docs/TESTING.md) for PowerShell and cPanel/Linux.
